title: Anti-rug precedence over in-flight exits and nonce-lock hold time

options.name: Keep current behaviour: an anti-rug exit is refused while the token sell lock is held and waits behind any private escalation on the wallet
options.risk: A rug during another exit is handled at routine parameters, or the anti-rug exit times out before it signs (AUD-EXIT-014).

options.name: When anti-rug fires during an in-flight exit of the same token, switch that exit to anti-rug parameters (one attempt, wider slippage, gas multiplier) instead of refusing
options.behavior_impact: The rug response is not lost.
options.risk: Changing an in-flight ladder needs care around the no-double-sell guard.

options.name: Hold the nonce lock per signed tx, not across a whole escalation, and size the watchdog from attempts * confirm window
options.behavior_impact: Exits on other tokens are not blocked for minutes.
options.risk: Nonce reconciliation must still be safe with interleaved signers (TX slice).

recommendation: escalate-in-flight together with short-lock-holds, designed with the TX slice RC-10 fix.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). This card covers S1 capital findings, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides whether an anti-rug exit always gets its emergency treatment.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
